integrity: Exact multivariate formulas and analytic Poisson-process convergence proved in RESULT.md; standalone finite checker is corroboration rather than an infinite proof. No assertion of externally established priority or independent certification.
limitations: Independent uniform parents with replacement; first-public archival model dated by the 2009-05-31 arXiv version. Fixed fan-in extreme point process requires k>=2. Growing fan-in Gumbel law requires k/log n tending to a positive finite constant. No quantitative rates, biased-parent, or distinct-parent analogues are claimed.
title: A Weibull-to-Gumbel frontier for the oldest childless vertices of recursive DAGs
